description: React component 'UsersList' that displays a list of users with filtering options including search, tenant, and date range. It fetches data from an API, supports filtering, and handles user interactions such as row clicks and deletions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches user data from the backend API, supporting optional startDate and endDate filters.

methods.name: resetFilters
methods.description: Resets all filters to their default states and reloads the user data.

methods.name: handleRowClick
methods.description: Handles click events on user rows, invoking callback functions if provided.
